responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE store-merging optimization pass. It scans basic blocks to collect mergeable memory stores into per-base chains, analyzes adjacent or bitfield-compatible stores to form merged groups, and emits fewer wider loads/stores or load-op-store sequences that preserve byte layout across endianness and alignment constraints; it also contains related byte-swapping support, CFG cleanup handling for exceptional edges, and checking-mode selftests for its byte-manipulation helpers.
